calls.statement:
WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines
    WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS ctl_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
    WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COALESCE(m.store_id, c.store_id) AS store_id, m.net_sales, c.ctl_net, m.net_sales - c.ctl_net AS diff
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.store_id = m.store_id
ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(m.net_sales,0) - COALESCE(c.ctl_net,0)) DESC, 1

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
days AS (
    SELECT calendar_date FROM dim_date
    WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 2 AND is_trading_day
),
trading AS (
    SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
    FROM dim_store cs CROSS JOIN days d
    WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
      AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= d.calendar_date)
      AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= d.calendar_date)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id
                      AND d.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
    GROUP BY 1
),
sales AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.net_sales / t.trading_days DESC) AS rank,
       cs.store_id, cs.store_name, ROUND(s.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales, t.trading_days,
       ROUND(s.net_sales / t.trading_days, 2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day
FROM sales s
JOIN trading t ON t.store_id = s.store_id
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
ORDER BY rank

SELECT f.sale_date, s.store_id, count(*) AS n, sum(f.net_amount) AS net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND s.store_id < 900 AND (s.store_id=125 AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2026-06-13' OR f.sale_date IN (DATE '2026-06-19', DATE '2026-06-20'))
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1 LIMIT 80
